name: storytelling
label: Storytelling
css: .style-storytelling { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; position: relative; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .style-storytelling::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 120% -20%, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; } .style-storytelling .hook { font-family: 'Abril Fatface', serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; } .style-storytelling .text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 85%; } .style-storytelling .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-family: 'Abril Fatface', serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; } .style-storytelling .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); letter-spacing: 0.5px; z-index: 2; } .slide-code.style-storytelling { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); } .slide-code.style-storytelling .hook { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-storytelling .text { color: #E5E7EB; } .slide-code.style-storytelling .step { color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-storytelling .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-code.style-storytelling::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 120% -20%, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-storytelling { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E293B 100%); } .slide-insight.style-storytelling .hook { color: #F0F9FF; } .slide-insight.style-storytelling .text { color: #CBD5E1; } .slide-insight.style-storytelling .insight-text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; color: #F0F9FF; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 80%; position: relative; z-index: 2; margin: 0; } .slide-insight.style-storytelling .step { color: #F0F9FF; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-storytelling .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-storytelling::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 120% -20%, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.2; }
